patterns: APPSC asks Koeppen codes as a code->region match (Amw west coast, As Coromandel, Cwg Ganga plain/NE, BShw NW India) and one-liners on controls ('distance from a river' is not a control).
Biome statements recur with a single false clause: taiga 'narrow temperature range' is the APPSC trap; Mediterranean = winter rain, no dry winter/no severe winter.
Peoples->region and grassland->country one-liners dominate other PSCs (Masai-savanna, Pygmies-Congo, Bushmen-Kalahari not Australia, Pampas-Argentina, Llanos-Venezuela, Zulu-South Africa).
Extremes asked directly: Death Valley heat, Atacama driest, Verkhoyansk/Vostok cold, Sahara largest hot desert.
App MCQs add many obscure tribe statements (Chukchi, Sakai, Ainu, Aeta) and wildlife-biome A-R items well beyond PYQ depth; PYQs stay at well-known groups.
